story_text: As a user, I want to register with the maximum allowed name length so that long names are handled correctly.

positive.title: Register successfully with name at maximum allowed length
steps: 1. Attempt to register with a name that is exactly at the maximum allowed length.
positive.expected_result: The registration is successful, and the system accepts the name without any errors.

positive.title: Store and display name at maximum length correctly
steps: 1. Attempt to register with a name that is exactly at the maximum allowed length.
positive.expected_result: The system stores and displays the name correctly without any issues.

negative.title: Accept name exceeding maximum length (validation failure)
steps: 1. Attempt to register with a name that exceeds the maximum allowed length.
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the registration attempt and displays an appropriate error message.

negative.title: System truncates name exceeding maximum length without error
steps: 1. Attempt to register with a name that exceeds the maximum allowed length.
negative.expected_result: The system truncates the name without displaying an error message.

negative.title: Return incorrect error message for name exceeding maximum length
steps: 1. Attempt to register with a name that exceeds the maximum allowed length.
negative.expected_result: The system displays an incorrect or misleading error message.

edge.title: Register with name exactly one character less than maximum length
steps: 1. Attempt to register with a name that is exactly one character less than the maximum allowed length.
edge.expected_result: The registration is successful, and the system accepts the name without any errors.

edge.title: Register with name exactly one character more than maximum length
steps: 1. Attempt to register with a name that is exactly one character more than the maximum allowed length.
edge.expected_result: The system rejects the registration attempt and displays an appropriate error message.

edge.title: Register with maximum length name via API without frontend validation
steps: 1. Attempt to register with a name that is exactly at the maximum allowed length using the API, bypassing frontend validation.
edge.expected_result: The system accepts the name and completes the registration successfully.
